title: [RT-DETR] TypeError in RTDetrModel.forward when num_feature_levels > len(backbone outputs)
author: c1prk

comments.author: saitejabandaru-in
comments.body:
Great bug report! I've submitted a fix in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46874.

The fix is a single bracket move — `[-1]` should index into the `last_hidden_state` list (selecting the last feature map) **before** passing to the Conv2d projection, not after. The correct pattern was already used on the very next line (L1628), making this a clear typo.

comments.author: c1prk
comments.body:
I've submitted a fix in #46833 roughly four days ago. I was unaware I had to write a comment addressing this.
The change is made in modular_rt_detr.py (the source of truth) and modeling_rt_detr.py is regenerated from it.
